SPMC makes history as first Mindanao gov’t hospital to adopt clinical AI

Philippine News Agency. . The Southern Philippines Medical Center in Davao City is set to become the first government hospital in Mindanao to adopt the UpToDate Expert AI clinical tool through a partnership with Wolters Kluwer, finalized through an agreem

Philippine News Agency. . The Southern Philippines Medical Center in Davao City is set to become the first government hospital in Mindanao to adopt the UpToDate Expert AI clinical tool through a partnership with Wolters Kluwer, finalized through an agreement signing on Monday (Nov. 16, 2026). The artificial intelligence-powered platform will provide clinicians with evidence-based medical information, with responses linked to expert-reviewed sources for verification. SPMC is the largest Department of Health-retained public hospital in the Philippines, with an authorized capacity of 1,500 beds. | PNA video by Robinson Niñal Jr.

SPMC TAPS AI TO SUPPORT DOCTORS, STRENGTHEN MINDANAO HEALTH CARE Doctors at the Southern Philippines Medical Center (SPMC) will now have faster access to trusted medical evidence to help guide clinical decisions as the hospital adopts artificial intelligence-powered clinical support. SPMC partnered with global health information provider Wolters Kluwer to introduce UpToDate Expert AI, becoming the first government hospital in the Southern Philippines to adopt the platform. The technology allows doctors to ask medical questions in plain language and receive answers based on expert-written, peer-reviewed medical content, with references they can trace and verify. UpToDate serves more than 3 million clinicians across 191 countries and territories. Its clinical resource features more than 13,000 topics contributed by 7,700 medical experts.
